skill.title: Real estate document review checks
skill.summary: A real estate review procedure for leases, estoppels, rent rolls, title and encumbrance materials, and transaction documents, with explicit checks for premises, money, dates, consents, cross-document consistency, and close-out of every required deliverable element.
instructions: Inventory property, lease, title, survey, estoppel, rent roll, and transaction documents, and identify the controlling instrument for each issue.

Build a requirements-to-deliverable checklist from the task instructions and map every required item, property, tenant, and calculation to its source support and planned output location; close each item explicitly before finishing.

Verify legal descriptions, premises, unit or acreage figures, allocations, and measurement bases against source schedules and independent arithmetic, extracting quantitative figures directly from source text with a repeatable method rather than relying on manual transcription.

Reconcile lease abstracts, rent rolls, estoppels, and underlying leases for parties, term, rent, escalations, options, and encumbrances, and confirm that every property and tenant in scope appears in the deliverable with all required fields.
Check title and encumbrance items against transaction requirements and identify required consents, releases, subordination, or estoppel documents.
Compute date-dependent obligations and prorations independently, and flag ambiguities in commencement, expiration, notice, or closing timing.
Confirm that every property-level conclusion is tied to a specific document and that missing, inconsistent, or unverified items are expressly flagged.
Before finalizing, run a requirement-by-requirement close-out against the task instructions and a separate completeness check for omitted properties, documents, fields, and calculations.
triggers: Lease, estoppel, rent roll, title, survey, or purchase agreement review
Real estate due diligence and closing checklist preparation
exclusions: Standalone land-use or zoning policy research
Property marketing material review without source documents
